I’ve been part of this surgery for a couple of months now, after experiencing very bad service and gaslighting from a GP at my previous surgery. They have been extremely helpful and efficient every single time I’ve contacted the Hedges. When I use the app to make an enquiry, I get contacted within an hour. If I ask about documents or have a general query, I get a prompt response either via message or telephone. I made a non-urgent health related enquiry the other week, and a GP called me within the hour, and I didn’t get told to call at 8am to make an appointment. GP spoke to me about the concern and suggested treatment after I sent some further information. Very easy and a relief after several years of being passed pillar to post at my other surgery.

—
**Edited March 2026**

I have now been registered at the surgery for over 12 months, and the service is still great. I have had no problems accessing treatment and support, and find the staff to be supportive and thorough.

After a few interactions over telephone or via the NHS app for non-urgent queries, I am dealt with quickly. I sent a message with some photos to follow-up another query, and the doctor even followed up with a specialist to ensure that my treatment was effective. I didn’t have to chase, or continue to pursue the same issue repeatedly, and this has been a breath of fresh air compared to other experiences at my previous surgery.

All of my in-person interactions have also been positive, I have always felt they were productive and the staff to be friendly and supportive during my visits.

Since my initial review, the treatment and support has not faltered or changed, and I’m glad that there is consistency across the board at this surgery.

I would recommend this surgery to anyone who lives locally. It is easily accessible via public transport, and has parking at the surgery and nearby if you drive.
